headingZh: 上升趨勢：原文歷史案例
en: The chart below is a plot of the price movement of the Apple Inc which made very good stride during March 2009 to May 2011. Strong uptrend can be seen from the movement. The stock price moved from 100 to 350 in about 2 years period.
zh: 下圖繪出蘋果公司在 2009 年 3 月至 2011 年 5 月的股價走勢，這段期間股價有顯著上漲。從走勢中可以看出強勁的上升趨勢。股價在大約兩年的期間，從 100 上升至 350。

headingZh: 本批續譯：泡沫情境的第一段討論
en: So when can a technician determine that markets are in a bubble scenario? When it exhibits poor market structure, most often in the form of prices that seem to defy gravity and logarithmic scale, with little or no pauses for consolidation. A true one-sided exhibition of delusional behavior that this trend will continue forever. Psychologically, this is complete lack of fear and greed at its best without any consideration of reasonable expectations.
zh: 那麼，技術分析者何時可以判定市場處於泡沫情境？當市場呈現不良的市場結構時，最常見的形式是價格彷彿不受重力與對數刻度約束，幾乎沒有或完全沒有停頓整理。這十足展現出一種片面的妄想行為：認為這種趨勢會永遠持續。從心理層面看，這是完全缺乏恐懼、貪婪發揮到極致，卻絲毫不考慮合理預期的狀態。
